title: Velocity at t=0.5s
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 8 m/s.

title: Magnitude of Acceleration
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 4 m/s².

title: Displacement in 2nd Second
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be 4 m.

title: Apply Midpoint Velocity Rule
description: Important: Correctly states or uses that for uniform acceleration, the average velocity over an interval equals the instantaneous velocity at the time midpoint.

title: Use Kinematic Equations
description: Important: Applies correct kinematic equations (e.g., s = ut + ½at²) to relate displacement, time, initial velocity, and acceleration.

title: Solve System of Equations
description: Important: Sets up and solves simultaneous equations using the given displacements in the 1st and 3rd seconds to find acceleration and initial velocity.

title: Calculate Intermediate Displacement
description: Optional: Correctly calculates the total displacement after 2 seconds before finding the displacement for the 2nd second interval.

title: Sign Error for Deceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses acceleration with incorrect sign (e.g., positive for a decelerating object) in the kinematic equations.

title: Confuses Time Intervals
description: Pitfall: Misinterprets 'displacement in the nth second' as the position at time t=n s, rather than the displacement during that one-second interval.
